instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a modern office interior during the day. In the center, three colleagues share a celebratory group hug. The man in the light beige blazer (R1) stands on the left with his back to the camera, yellow sticky notes reading '1000' and 'GOALS' stuck to his jacket. He hugs the woman in the beige sweater vest (R3), who is partially obscured in the middle, and the man in the beige polo shirt (R4) on the right. The man (R4) is in profile, wearing glasses and smiling warmly as he wraps his arm around the others. The background features soft, out-of-focus office plants and shelves under warm, natural indoor lighting.
